experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: A selection of professional, freelance, and academic projects where I connected product, technology, and real needs.

clinic.title: Clínica Chamán - Corporate website
clinic.description: I designed and developed the institutional WordPress website with a focus on conversion, user experience, and simple administration. I also implemented a custom PHP plugin for block-based pre-bookings, with an administration panel, capacity and status management, email notifications, and proof uploads.

kunic.title: KunicProduccionesSpa - E-commerce
kunic.description: I developed a web platform with WordPress, Elementor, and WooCommerce. I integrated ShopLentor, FiboSearch, LiteSpeed Cache, and Image Optimizer to improve search, performance, navigation, SEO, and conversion.

fitness.title: Tu Evolución Fitness - SPA
fitness.description: I developed a Single Page Application to present a gym's services and strengthen its digital presence. The solution was built with React.js and Tailwind CSS, prioritizing responsive design, fast loading, and clarity for the end user.

btg.title: BTG Pactual - Risk management
btg.description: I contributed to the frontend development of a financial risk management platform using Next.js and React.js, adding advanced TanStack Table features. I participated in adapting the bank's internal component library with Figma, Storybook, vanilla CSS, and Tailwind CSS, along with Git Enterprise and Git Gogs.

network.title: Vidriería Almagro - Wireless network
network.description: I planned and implemented a wireless network to improve the company's connectivity and internal communication. The work included equipment configuration, coverage optimization, signal stability, and access to digital resources.

fireWarning.title: Fire Warning - Applied AI
fireWarning.description: I participated in a fire detection project using artificial intelligence. We used Python and TensorFlow for the model, together with React.js and Django for real-time camera visualization and alert generation. The project was highlighted at Duoc UC Demo Day.
